comments.author: maxbond
comments.story: Sabine Hossenfelder: I think faster than light travel is possible. Here's why
comments.why: High speed Schlieren footage illustrating shockwave overtaking disturbance.
comments.text: Point taken. Thanks for the explanation, that helped me a achieve a deeper understanding & blew my mind. This animation of a tachyon goes well with your explanation: [LINK] If you look for it, you can observe this effect in the high speed Schlieren footage of a whip in this video [VIDEO] (you can skip to around 8 minutes) It starts to disturb the air, then the shockwave overtakes the disturbance, so you can observe them in the flipped order if you're in the sound universe.
